title: Workmen of Meenakshi Mills Ltd. v. Meenakshi Mills Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Workmen of Meenakshi Mills Ltd. v. Meenakshi Mills Ltd., (1992) 3 SCC 336
content.facts: The Court considered the constitutional and statutory safeguards governing retrenchment.
questionsBeforeCourt: How should retrenchment controls be reconciled with management and economic interests?
content.ratioDecidendi: Retrenchment safeguards are conditions precedent and must be complied with according to the protective statutory scheme.
content.holding: The Court upheld scrutiny of statutory compliance.
content.relevance: Use for retrenchment and industrial adjudication.
